summary: Product leader with a background in consumer fintech payments at Starling Bank and Revolut, focused on shipping features that measurably improve outcomes for large user bases. Experienced in owning problems end to end and using data to track results, including a 34% reduction in settlement failures and an 18% reduction in chargeback disputes on a product used by 2.1 million customers.

bullets: Owned the Faster Payments integration, cutting settlement failures by 34%
Led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers
Built payments features and led hiring for the team
Launched card controls used by 2.1 million customers
Reduced chargeback disputes by 18% by redesigning the claims flow
